name: about-architecture

frames.best_why: The full headline, the right-hand paragraph and both building photos are visible at once.

tagline: Oversized architecture headline over two grayscale tower photos.
summary: A white studio about block with a giant 'Building Modernity.' headline, a short positioning note and two tall greyscale building photos set at different heights.
appearance: A white page with a tiny spaced eyebrow above an enormous black headline, its second word set in italic. A narrow grey paragraph aligns right, above two tall greyscale skyscraper photos that sit at offset heights.
behaviour: The eyebrow and headline slide in from the left as they enter view. Each photo stays greyscale until hovered, then slowly returns to full colour.
demo_content: Headline 'Building Modernity.', 'Established 1984' and two greyscale skyscraper photos.
search_phrases: giant type over grayscale building photos
two tall photos offset on white
grayscale photos that colour on hover
established since label above big heading
use_when: An architecture or design studio wants a restrained editorial about block led by type and photos.
avoid_when: Photos are hardcoded and the colour-on-hover reveal never happens on touch.
customise: Headline, paragraph, photo URLs and captions live in the JSX; grayscale timing and spacing are classes.
weight_why: Two photos and a couple of fade-ins once; no loop.

a11y.note: The colour-on-hover reveal is desktop only, and reduced motion is not honoured.

issues: Photo captions use mix-blend-difference over pale skies, so they can disappear.
The photos only gain colour on hover, which touch users never trigger.
polish_why: Bold type-led layout with a strong photo rhythm; the captions are faint.
title: About Architecture Studio
